# KitWise Studio · Holiday printables

> KitWise Studio makes printable Christmas party games, planners and activity packs in English and Spanish, sold as instant PDF downloads on Gumroad (kitwisestudio.gumroad.com) and Etsy (shop KitWiseStudios).

## Pages
- [Printable Christmas party games for family, friends and office parties](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/fiestas/): The 10 Christmas party games that work for mixed ages and big groups, how to run Christmas bingo for 30 people, and a printable bundle with all of them.
- [Juegos de Navidad para imprimir en familia: bingo, trivial y más (PDF)](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/fiestas/juegos-de-navidad-para-imprimir.html): Los juegos navideños que funcionan con niños, abuelos y adultos a la vez: bingo de Navidad, trivial navideño, pictionary, amigo invisible y más, listos para imprimir.
- [Cómo organizar el amigo invisible paso a paso (reglas, presupuesto e ideas)](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/fiestas/amigo-invisible-como-organizarlo.html): Reglas del amigo invisible, cómo hacer el sorteo sin que nadie se toque a sí mismo, qué presupuesto poner y variantes divertidas.
- [Christmas planning checklist: what to do in November and December](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/fiestas/christmas-planning-checklist.html): A week-by-week Christmas countdown from early November to Christmas Eve: budget, gift list, cards, menu, shopping and party, with a printable planner.
